last_election.results_note: Official 2022 first-round result mapped onto the 2027 field: Macron 27.85 split 60/40 Attal/Philippe, Pecresse -> Retailleau, Jadot -> Tondelier, Hidalgo -> Faure; Lassalle (3.13) unmodelled (Other wedge). Department baselines use the same inheritance.
last_election.runoff_note: 2022 runoff (Le Pen 41.45 / Macron 58.55); the 2027 runoff projection reads the head-to-head polls (Philippe vs Le Pen leads with 11 polls) with no first-round blend (the 2022-share renormalization is meaningless with an unsettled field).

notes: The 2027 candidate field is unsettled: the first-round polls test alternative hypothetical fields (19-33 columns across periods; the same pollster/date can appear in several scenario rows). scrape_france.py merges scenario rows by (pollster, fieldwork end date), each candidate taking the first tested value; candidates are matched by their linked name. The runoff pair is picked from the head-to-head section headings (X vs. Y) and the top pair by poll frequency drives the runoff card. Live again 2026-10-11. The map was rebuilt 2026-10-11 from GADM 4.1 (96 metropolitan departments; the old b40 map was missing Paris/92/93/94); the map units are the departments.
